sources.title: Urban planning & construction
sources.verified_claim: TfL provides planning-application, spatial-planning, Transport Assessment, modelling, infrastructure-protection and conveyancing tools for developments in London; these services identify requirements but do not establish parcel capacity.

sources.title: Our role in planning
sources.verified_claim: TfL integrates land-use and transport planning, assesses referable development in relevant circumstances, mitigates impacts and can seek developer funding for transport investment; application outcomes remain site specific.

sources.title: Our land and infrastructure
sources.verified_claim: TfL requires developers to address effects on its roads, railways, land and transport assets and provides routes for highway licences and works near assets; interface risk needs site-level confirmation.

sources.title: Planning obligations
sources.verified_claim: TfL prefers design mitigation before obligations and may seek transport-related S106 or CIL-supported measures where development impacts require them; no obligation is assumed for a sample parcel without proposal evidence.

sources.title: Guidance for planning applicants
sources.verified_claim: TfL expects planning applications to apply Healthy Streets and provides guidance on transport assessments, trip generation, freight, highway works and mitigation; guidance is not approval.

sources.title: Infrastructure Coordination Development Service
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's service works with developers on utilities capacity, highways and transport interfaces and can coordinate licences and approvals as construction approaches; it reduces project risk but does not confirm capacity at a sample parcel.

sources.title: Road construction (Sections 38 and 278)
sources.verified_claim: Havering explains Section 38 adoption agreements and Section 278 agreements for developer-funded highway alterations connected to planning approval; actual requirements depend on the specific development.

sources.title: Road adoption
sources.verified_claim: Enfield provides adopted-road enquiries and Section 278/38 agreement routes, with council approval, legal fees, bonds and supervision required before relevant works; no parcel-specific highway status is inferred.
